description: This file defines the EntityOperations class for Drupal Views, responsible for rendering operation links for entities within the Views module. It manages options, rendering logic, and entity-related dependencies.

classes.name: EntityOperations
classes.description: A plugin class for rendering entity operation links within Drupal Views, handling options, rendering, and entity management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies like entity type manager, language manager, and entity repository.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the query uses GROUP BY clause; returns FALSE.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for the plugin, including a checkbox for 'Include destination'.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders operation links for a given entity, adding destination parameters if configured.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Custom query method that integrates with entity translation rendering if multilingual.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Returns the entity type manager service.

methods.name: clickSortable
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is sortable via click; returns FALSE.
